title: Beyond Static Positional Encoding: Bayesian Time-aware Attention for Non-Stationary Long-term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.19603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers have demonstrated strong performance in long-term time series forecasting (LTSF), yet modeling non-stationary temporal dependencies remains challenging. In this paper, we interpret self-attention as a Bayesian posterior over attended positions, combining a content-based prior induced by scaled dot-product similarity with a temporal-evidence likelihood induced by positional encoding. This formulation provides a probabilistic interpretation of how positional encoding shapes the temporal dependencies captured by self-attention. Building on this perspective, we derive a population-level evidence lower bound (ELBO) that characterizes the role of positional encoding in forecasting weakly stationary time series. translated_title: 超越静态位置编码：面向非平稳长期时间序列预测的贝叶斯时间感知注意力机制
translated_abstract: Transformer已在长期时间序列预测（LTSF）中展现出强大的性能，然而对非平稳时间依赖关系的建模仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们将自注意力解释为注意力位置上的贝叶斯后验，将由缩放点积相似度诱导的基于内容的先验，与由位置编码诱导的时间证据似然相结合。这一表述为位置编码如何塑造自注意力所捕获的时间依赖关系提供了概率解释。基于这一视角，我们推导出一个总体层面的证据下界（ELBO），刻画了位置编码在预测弱平稳时间序列中的作用。我们的分析进一步揭示了静态位置编码的一个局限性：当时间依赖结构在不同输入窗口之间存在差异时，固定的时间偏差必须适应异构的动态特性，因此可能是次优的。
tldr: 该论文从贝叶斯视角将自注意力解释为内容先验与时间证据似然结合的后验，并推导总体层面的ELBO，据此揭示了静态位置编码在非平稳长期时间序列预测中的局限性，提出贝叶斯时间感知注意力机制以应对非平稳时间依赖建模的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper interprets self-attention as a Bayesian posterior combining a content-based prior with a temporal-evidence likelihood, derives a population-level ELBO characterizing the role of positional encoding, and reveals the limitation of static positional encoding in non-stationary long-term time series forecasting, proposing Bayesian time-aware attention to address heterogeneous temporal dependencies.
